about: AP Microeconomics concept dependency map (docs/apmicro-spec.md, docs/apmicro-phase0.md): the 36 topics of the CED in order, the "Graph skills you need" topics (placed before Unit 1), and every concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. Built by Phase 0 from docs/apmicro-ced-map.json; edited by hand from now on. Authors add every term a topic teaches that the map lacks.

ced.edition: Course and Exam Description, effective fall 2026, unchanged in content for 2026-27 (6 units, 36 topics)
ced.note: Built from docs/apmicro-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apmicro-research/framework.md. Essential knowledge for 3.4 to 6.5 from scoring guidelines, Chief Reader Reports and standard economics (docs/apmicro-needs-author.md, ced-text).

bigIdeas.name: Scarcity and Markets
bigIdeas.summary: How scarcity forces choices and how markets set prices and quantities.

bigIdeas.name: Costs, Benefits, and Marginal Analysis
bigIdeas.summary: How consumers and firms compare costs and benefits at the margin.

bigIdeas.name: Production Choices and Behavior
bigIdeas.summary: How firms produce, set prices and hire in different market structures.

bigIdeas.name: Market Inefficiency and Public Policy
bigIdeas.summary: When markets fail and how policy changes outcomes.

everydayWords.about: Common words a student already roughly knows. They may be used in their everyday sense before the topic that teaches them; the technical terms of the same concept stay strict ("marginal revenue product", "deadweight loss", "price elasticity" are not used early).
